page.overview:
What is Anzellan Droidsmiths?

The Anzellan Droidsmiths were a legendary crew of four (originally three) Anzellan droidsmiths living on the planet Nevarro. By the time of the New Republic, they found great commercial success when Nevarro was thriving, as they had precise and affordable expertise to keep automated excavation equipment used for belt mining running under extreme conditions. High Magistrate Greef Karga tasked them to keep his administrative droids and foot droids operational. They were requested by Din Djarin to fix IG-11, who previously self-destructed. The Anzellans could not fix the droid, because his memory circuit was broken, a component that was very hard to find at that time as they were not being made anymore.

The crew initially consisted of a trio named Minch, Keeto and Bai. The four helped Djarin make modifications on his new ship, the Razor Crest 2.0. Although one night Embo and his anooba Keibu came to Nevarro and kidnapped Djarin and by accident Minch. The other three left with Grogu in their Anzellan Starship to Nal Hutta, where they rescued both but Djarin was too big to fit in their starship and so he and Grogu stayed behind but the droidsmiths came back with Adelphi Rangers lead by Colonel Ward to rescue Djarin, Grogu, and Rotta.
